basic_info.description: Stunning Designer Renovation! Beautifully renovated on both levels, bright open floor plan, quality finishes and attention to detail throughout. This home has a great flow and feel, four bedrooms + home office and family room, five full bathrooms. Open dining area has plenty of room for large dinner parties and blends nicely to the gorgeous chef's kitchen with beautiful stone and tile accents with top-of-the-line Thermador appliances. Three en-suite style bedrooms off hallway each with their own private bathrooms. Primary bedroom has double vanity with deep soaking tub, separate stall shower. Private lower-level suite, walk-out deck, large garden, 2-3 car parking with EV charger in garage.  All updated systems, brand new appliances and fixtures. Great location, half block to vibrant Clement Street restaurants, cafes and stores. Close to parks, playgrounds, beaches, Geary commercial corridor and various MUNI lines.
